tables.label: TABLE 1
tables.caption: Evaluation values of the classifiers tested with the databases retrieved for generating each classifier: AMPValidate, and the random forest classifiers for the AMPSolve module (cell-penetrating capacity (CPC), toxicity and hemolysis)a
footnotes: Values for accuracy, false positive rate (FPR), false negative rate (FNR) and the Matthew’s correlation coefficient (MCC) are shown. The performance of other classifiers with the same testing set is added for comparison.
Gray shading in the table is used to differentiate various predictions. Boldface is used to highlight the best pedictors and their respectives values.

tables.label: TABLE 2
tables.caption: Minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC), hemolysis, and cytotoxicity of peptides
footnotes: Sequences and additional data on the peptides are given in Table S1.
Measured as the percentage of hemolysis at 150 µM peptide concentration.
Measured as the IC50 in µM units in HepG2 cells.
